evidence_class: retrospective saved-data analysis; no new runtime observations
reference: Each history's own measured epoch-0 allocation
example_origin: Reuse the example fixed before the main execution; no favorable replacement
transfer_example_origin: Retrospective illustration: first repetition and first transfer at moderate load in each initial context
relative_check_class: Apply the first observed relative multiplier to each example's initial composition. Transformed states are unexecuted and receive no SLO labels.
witness_context: Same initial allocation and workload; different runner pairs; all selected cumulative local coordinates equal at every observed epoch of a prefix
uncertainty_unit: Complete baseline-safe runner pairs, at fixed epoch 20; descriptive percentile intervals for median contrasts
scope: Full raw shares and ILR preserve the same state information. Known relative geometry is distinguished from empirical consequence prediction. CPU alone moves; RAM is an initial context. No universal detector superiority, causal allocation-only risk law or dynamic CPU/RAM claim.
